summary: ADR-0058 accepted 2026-08-18; Acceptance-owned persisted runs, action DAGs, append-only events, command registries, route projections, and receipts are evidence root; requests identify target plan and prepared input only, never current route/lifecycle truth; action results bind run,event,registry,candidate,contract,Knowledge,Skill-input,validator IDs; v2 request material historical-only and cannot publish completion; coordinator reentrant/replayable from persisted evidence; reject caller-complete graphs,mismatched receipts,unregistered actions; Acceptance solely owns acceptance-passed; no Bootstrap ownership/autostart; no release or commit authority
